answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the terrace log reveals the live set and the sonnet audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 316 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 281 aliases alive therefore means 281 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the quill quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
